name: ribbon-highway-pay
about: A sound ad: a white tractor and van on a prairie highway at dusk, the pay below it. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `ribbon` look (centred Anton headline, pill button, a hairline over the legal line): the same photo, words and kit as `clean-highway-pay`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: nothing planted: the subject is clear, the plate is the kit's green, the headline over the truck

subject_legible.reason: A white tractor and trailer sits sharp and side-on on an open highway under a sunset sky, readable instantly at phone size.

words_match_picture.reason: A per-mile OTR pay headline sits over a long-haul rig on an open rural highway, so words and picture tell the same over-the-road story.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The big white headline on the dark green wash reads first, the white pill button second, and the truck sits calmly above without fighting them.

looks_like_kit.reason: The dark green overlay, white headline and white button with green lettering match the two brand colours; no logo was supplied and none appears.
